notes: U1 ref disambiguated among three Legacy Gallery signs and replacement made structural; U2 lamp post disambiguated from gooseneck lamps, tint -> color; U4 door already has handles, payload changed to a wreath. Masks unchanged.

spec.ref: the green Legacy Gallery sign above the central entrance
spec.payload: a hanging wooden sign shaped like a painter's palette

units.ref_zh: 中央入口上方的绿色Legacy Gallery招牌
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将中央入口上方的绿色Legacy Gallery招牌替换为一块调色板形状的悬挂木牌。
units.reason: Self-found: three Legacy Gallery signs exist; the masked one is the dark green emblem sign over the entrance. 'a blue ART GALLERY sign' was mostly a recolour/text change; now a structurally different sign.

spec.ref: the street lamp post in front of the right storefront

units.instruction_ref_zh: 将右侧店面前的路灯杆的颜色改为亮黑色。
units.reason: Mask is the tall pale-gray street lamp post (x1456-1507); the facade's green gooseneck lamps are now excluded by 'street lamp post'; tint of a lamp was unclear, now a colour change to a visibly different value.

units.instruction_ref_zh: 在中央的木质入口门上加上一个圆形常青花环。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域加上一个圆形常青花环。
units.reason: Door already has two round handles; a wreath on the door is a natural new item without needing a site.
